prose:
9to5Google describes Gemini 4 Neon’s placement in the product family, paid-app availability and changes to the model picker. It distinguishes Neon list prices from temporary promotional prices for other models.

The report is launch coverage, not verification of any individual account’s access. Pricing comparisons depend on the promotion period, and the article’s app details do not establish identical availability in every region or product.
highlights: Paid-product access differs from API access
Context and effort settings are described
